answer_1.quote: ...We evaluate FACTEDIT on two datasets -CNN/DailyMail and XSum and across nine summarization models... The goal of our work is to develop post-editing models that generalize over a wider range of factual errors in generated summaries...

answer_2.quote: ...We evaluate our model using two metrics -FactCC ... and Ent-DAE ... We also report ROUGE to evaluate if our model maintains the fluency of summaries.

answer_4.quote: ...Two annotators evaluated 20 randomly sampled summaries generated from the test set of the XSum dataset ... and asked to rate the fluency and factuality of the summary on a 1-5 Likert scale...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were shown the source document and a corrected summary and asked to rate fluency and factuality on a 1-5 Likert scale.
